description: This file defines a Catalyst controller for managing organization members, including listing, adding, editing, transferring ownership, and removing members within an organization.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Organization::Member
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for managing organization members, providing actions for listing, adding, editing, transferring ownership, and removing members.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list organization members, including generating URLs for user profiles, transfer of ownership, removal, and editing, as well as listing users without membership.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new user to the organization with a specified role.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Chained method to fetch and set the membership object based on username parameter.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update the role of an existing organization member.

methods.name: make_owner
methods.description: Handles POST requests to transfer organization ownership to a member.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Handles POST requests to remove a member from the organization.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Private method to redirect to the organization members list page.
